site_standard: 915.02 grading; 906.08 SS-O if slope>=25%; per-unit density minimum repealed by Ord. 10-2025
site_standard_summary: Grading, cut and fill standards apply (§915.02). Steep Slope Overlay review applies only where slope is 25% or more (§906.08).

site_standard: 915.02 grading; 906.08 SS-O if slope>=25%; attached P/S per 911.04.A.69A; per-unit density minimum repealed by Ord. 10-2025
site_standard_summary: Grading, cut and fill standards apply (§915.02). Steep Slope Overlay review applies only where slope is 25% or more (§906.08). Attached single-unit dwellings follow §911.04.A.69A.

site_standard: no minimum lot size (row deleted by Ord. 10-2025); 915.02 grading
site_standard_summary: No minimum lot size. Grading, cut and fill standards apply (§915.02).

site_standard: 915.02 grading; 906.08 SS-O if slope>=25%; 906.05 UM-O limits >single-unit structures; per-unit density minimum repealed by Ord. 10-2025
site_standard_summary: Grading, cut and fill standards apply (§915.02). Steep Slope Overlay review applies only where slope is 25% or more (§906.08). In the Undermined Area Overlay, structures larger than a typical single-unit dwelling need a site investigation (§906.05).

site_standard: 915.02 grading; 906.08 SS-O if slope>=25%; per-unit density minimum repealed by Ord. 10-2025
site_standard_summary: Grading, cut and fill standards apply (§915.02). Steep Slope Overlay review applies only where slope is 25% or more (§906.08).

site_standard: 911.04.A.69 survey-dependent slope/soils/access/utility conditions; clearing cap max(10%/2400 sf) per 911.04.A.69(b); 50% max disturbance; setbacks none per 905.02.C; site plan review 905.02.C.3
site_standard_summary: Single-unit housing needs an Administrator Exception: a survey must show a contiguous area under 30% slope for the house, with adequate soils, access and utilities (§911.04.A.69). Clearing is capped at the larger of 10% of the lot or 2,400 sf (§911.04.A.69(b)), and at most 50% of the lot may be disturbed. No base setbacks (§905.02.C); site plan review applies (§905.02.C.3).

site_standard: Site plan review for lots >=2400 sf (905.01.D.1(a)); FAR 1:1
site_standard_summary: Site plan review applies to new construction on lots of 2,400 sf or more (§905.01.D). Floor-area ratio is limited to 1:1.

site_standard: Rear 20 ft only when not adjacent to a way; site plan review for lots >=2400 sf (904.02.D); Ch. 916 compatibility
site_standard_summary: Site plan review applies on lots of 2,400 sf or more (§904.02.D). The 20 ft rear setback applies only when the rear lot line is not on a way. Residential compatibility standards apply (Ch. 916).

site_standard: Neither housing use permitted (Multi-Unit is S in UI)
site_standard_summary: Neither single-unit nor two-unit housing is permitted (§911.02).

site_standard: Build-to zone 0-10 ft (60% facade); rear 5 ft (2 ft at a way); side setbacks 0 ft; no minimum lot size; min height 24 ft; 125 ft riparian buffer
site_standard_summary: RIV-RM (§905.04.E): 0–10 ft build-to zone for 60% of the facade; 5 ft rear setback (2 ft at a way); no stated side setback or minimum lot size; 24 ft minimum height; 125 ft riparian buffer.
